sentences.en: MAN: Hello
sentences.zh: MAN: 你好。

sentences.en: Do you mind if I ask you some questions about your journey today?
sentences.zh: 您介意我问您几个关于今天行程的问题吗？

sentences.en: We're doing a customer satisfaction survey
sentences.zh: 我们正在进行一项客户满意度调查。

sentences.en: SOPHIE: Yes
sentences.zh: SOPHIE: 是的。

sentences.en: OK
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I've got about ten minutes before my train home leaves
sentences.zh: 我的返程火车还有大约十分钟就要发车了。

sentences.en: I'm on a day trip
sentences.zh: 我今天是来一日游的。

sentences.en: MAN: Great
sentences.zh: MAN: 太好了。

sentences.en: Thank you
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: So first of all, could you tell me your name?
sentences.zh: 那么，首先，您能告诉我您的姓名吗？

sentences.en: SOPHIE: It's Sophie Bird
sentences.zh: SOPHIE: 我叫索菲·伯德。

sentences.en: MAN: Thank you
sentences.zh: MAN: 谢谢。

sentences.en: And would you mind telling me what you do?
sentences.zh: 您介意告诉我您的职业吗？

sentences.en: SOPHIE: I'm a journalist
sentences.zh: SOPHIE: 我是一名记者。

sentences.en: MAN: Oh really?
sentences.zh: MAN: 哦，真的吗？

sentences.en: That must be interesting
sentences.zh: 那一定很有趣。

sentences.en: SOPHIE: Yes
sentences.zh: SOPHIE: 是的。

sentences.en: It is
sentences.zh: 确实很有趣。

sentences.en: MAN: So was the reason for your visit here today work?
sentences.zh: MAN: 那么，您今天来这里的目的是工作吗？

sentences.en: SOPHIE: Actually, it's my day off
sentences.zh: SOPHIE: 其实今天是我休息日。

sentences.en: I came here to do some shopping
sentences.zh: 我来这儿是为了购物。

sentences.en: MAN: Oh right
sentences.zh: MAN: 哦，明白了。

sentences.en: SOPHIE: But I do sometimes come here for work
sentences.zh: SOPHIE: 但我有时也会因工作来这里。

sentences.en: MAN: OK
sentences.zh: MAN: 好的。

sentences.en: Now I'd like to ask some questions about your journey today, if that's OK
sentences.zh: 现在我想问您几个关于今天行程的问题，可以吗？

sentences.en: SOPHIE: Yes
sentences.zh: SOPHIE: 是的。

sentences.en: No problem
sentences.zh: 没问题。

sentences.en: MAN: Right, SO can you tell me which station you're travelling back to?
sentences.zh: MAN: 好的，那么您能告诉我您要返回哪个车站吗？

sentences.en: SOPHIE: Staunfirth, where I live
sentences.zh: SOPHIE: 斯托恩菲尔斯，我就住在那里。

sentences.en: MAN: Can just check the spelling?
sentences.zh: MAN: 我可以确认一下拼写吗？

sentences.en: S-T-A-U-N-F-I-R-T-H?
sentences.zh: S-T-A-U-N-F-I-R-T-H？

sentences.en: SOPHIE: That's right
sentences.zh: SOPHIE: 没错。

sentences.en: MAN: And you travelled from there this morning?
sentences.zh: MAN: 您今天早上是从那里出发的吗？

sentences.en: SOPHIE: Yes
sentences.zh: SOPHIE: 是的。

sentences.en: MAN: OK, good
sentences.zh: MAN: 好的，很好。

sentences.en: Next, can I ask what kind of ticket you bought? assume it wasn't a season ticket, as you don't travel every day
sentences.zh: 接下来，我可以问问您买的是哪种车票吗？我假设您买的不是季票，因为您并非每天通勤。

sentences.en: SOPHIE: That's right
sentences.zh: SOPHIE: 没错。

sentences.en: No, I just got a normal return ticket
sentences.zh: 没有，我只是买了普通的往返票。

sentences.en: I don't have a rail card so I didn't get any discount. keep meaning to get one because it's lot cheaper
sentences.zh: 我没有铁路卡，所以没享受任何折扣。我一直打算办一张，因为那样会便宜很多。

sentences.en: MAN: Yes - you'd have saved 20% on your ticket today
sentences.zh: MAN: 是的——您今天买票时本可节省20%的费用。

sentences.en: So you paid the full price for your ticket?
sentences.zh: 那么，您是按全价购买的车票吗？

sentences.en: SOPHIE: paid £23.70
sentences.zh: SOPHIE: 支付了23.70英镑。

sentences.en: MAN: OK
sentences.zh: MAN: 好的。

sentences.en: Do you think that's good value for money?
sentences.zh: 您觉得这个价格物有所值吗？

sentences.en: SOPHIE: Not really
sentences.zh: SOPHIE: 并不 really。

sentences.en: I think it's too much for a journey that only takes 45 minutes
sentences.zh: 我觉得对于一趟仅需45分钟的行程来说，票价太高了。

sentences.en: MAN: Yes, that's one of the main complaints we get
sentences.zh: MAN: 是的，这是我们收到的主要投诉之一。

sentences.en: So, you didn't buy your ticket in advance?
sentences.zh: 所以，您并没有提前购票？

sentences.en: SOPHIE: No
sentences.zh: SOPHIE: 没有。

sentences.en: I know it's cheaper if you buy a week in advance but I didn't know I was coming then
sentences.zh: 我知道如果提前三天购票会更便宜，但那时我还不知道自己要来。

sentences.en: MAN: know
sentences.zh: MAN: 明白。

sentences.en: You can't always plan ahead
sentences.zh: 您并不总能提前规划。

sentences.en: So, did you buy it this morning?
sentences.zh: 那么，您是今天早上买的票吗？

sentences.en: SOPHIE: No, it was yesterday
sentences.zh: SOPHIE: 不是，是昨天买的。

sentences.en: MAN: Right
sentences.zh: MAN: 好的。

sentences.en: And do you usually buy your tickets at the station?
sentences.zh: 您通常是在车站买票吗？

sentences.en: SOPHIE: Well, do usually but the ticket office closes early and hate using ticket machines
sentences.zh: SOPHIE: 嗯，通常是这样，但售票处关门很早，而且我讨厌使用自动售票机。

sentences.en: I think ticket offices should be open for longer hours
sentences.zh: 我觉得售票处应该延长营业时间。

sentences.en: There's always a queue for the machines and they're often out of order
sentences.zh: 自动售票机前总是排着长队，而且经常出故障。

sentences.en: MAN: A lot of customers are saying the same thing
sentences.zh: MAN: 很多顾客都在反映同样的问题。

sentences.en: SOPHIE: So to answer your question
sentences.zh: SOPHIE: 所以，回答您的问题……

sentences.en: I got an e-ticket online
sentences.zh: 我是在线购买的电子车票。

sentences.en: MAN: OK
sentences.zh: MAN: 好的。

sentences.en: Thank you
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Now I'd like to ask you about your satisfaction with your journey
sentences.zh: 接下来，我想向您了解一下您对本次旅程的满意度。

sentences.en: So what would you say you were most satisfied with today?
sentences.zh: 那么，您觉得今天最满意的是哪一方面？

sentences.en: SOPHIE: Well, I like the wifi on the train
sentences.zh: SOPHIE: 嗯，我喜欢列车上的Wi-Fi。

sentences.en: It's improved a lot
sentences.zh: 它改善了很多。

sentences.en: It makes it easier for me to work if I want to
sentences.zh: 这让我需要时更容易工作。

sentences.en: MAN: That's the first time today anyone's mentioned that
sentences.zh: MAN: 今天还是第一次有人提到这一点。

sentences.en: It's good to get to some positive feedback on that
sentences.zh: 听到关于这方面的正面反馈真好。

sentences.en: SOPHIE: Mmm
sentences.zh: SOPHIE: 嗯。

sentences.en: MAN: And, is there anything you weren't satisfied with?
sentences.zh: MAN: 还有，有没有什么让您不满意的地方？

sentences.en: SOPHIE: Well, normally, the trains run on time and are pretty reliable but today there was a delay; the train was about 15 minutes behind schedule
sentences.zh: SOPHIE: 嗯，通常列车准点运行，可靠性也很高，但今天出现了延误；列车比预定时间晚了约15分钟。

sentences.en: MAN: OK
sentences.zh: MAN: 好的。

sentences.en: I'll put that down
sentences.zh: 我会记下来。

sentences.en: Now I'd also like to ask about the facilities at this station. at You've probably noticed that the whole station's been upgraded
sentences.zh: 另外，我还想向您了解一下这个车站的设施。您可能已经注意到，整个车站都已升级改造。

sentences.en: What are you most satisfied with?
sentences.zh: 您最满意的是哪一点？

sentences.en: SOPHIE: I think the best thing is that they've improved the amount of information about train times etc. that's given to passengers - it's much clearer - before there was only one board and couldn't always see it properly - which was frustrating
sentences.zh: SOPHIE: 我觉得最好的改进是提升了向乘客提供的列车时刻等信息的数量——现在信息清晰多了；以前只有一块显示屏，而且我常常看不清楚——这让人很沮丧。

sentences.en: MAN: That's good
sentences.zh: MAN: 那很好。

sentences.en: And is there anything you're not satisfied with?
sentences.zh: 还有没有什么您不满意的地方？

sentences.en: SOPHIE: Let's see
sentences.zh: SOPHIE: 让我想想……

sentences.en: I think things have generally improved a lot
sentences.zh: 我觉得总体上改善了很多。

sentences.en: The trains are much more modern and I like the new café
sentences.zh: 火车现代化程度高多了，而且我也很喜欢新开的咖啡馆。

sentences.en: But one thing is that there aren't enough places to sit down, especially on the platforms
sentences.zh: 但有一件事是：可供坐下的地方不够多，尤其是在站台上。

sentences.en: MAN: OK - so I'll put 'seating' down, shall as the thing you're least satisfied with?
sentences.zh: MAN: 好的——那我就把‘座位’列为最让您不满意的事项，可以吗？

sentences.en: SOPHIE: Yes
sentences.zh: SOPHIE: 是的。

sentences.en: OK
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: MAN: Can I ask your opinion about some of the other facilities?
sentences.zh: MAN: 我可以请教一下您对其他一些设施的看法吗？

sentences.en: We'd like feedback on whether people are satisfied, dissatisfied or neither satisfied nor dissatisfied
sentences.zh: 我们希望了解大家对各项设施的满意度反馈，即：满意、不满意，或既不满意也不满意。

sentences.en: SOPHIE: OK
sentences.zh: SOPHIE: 好的。

sentences.en: MAN: What about the parking at the station?
sentences.zh: MAN: 那车站的停车场呢？

sentences.en: SOPHIE: Well to be honest, I don't really have an opinion as I never use it
sentences.zh: SOPHIE: 嗯，说实话，我其实没什么看法，因为我从不使用它。

sentences.en: MAN: So, neither satisfied nor dissatisfied for that then
sentences.zh: MAN: 那么这一项就记为‘既不满意也不不满意’。

sentences.en: SOPHIE: Yes, I suppose SO
sentences.zh: SOPHIE: 是的，我想是这样。

sentences.en: MAN: OK, and what about ...?
sentences.zh: MAN: 好的，那关于……？
